reviewed_by: Claude, USG curator under DEC-005, acting for Gottfried Schmidtke
summary: An external AI routed correctly to S00 but bundled anticipated downstream questions (span, ownership, project type) into its first turn. Proposes a no_future_question_bundling invariant and an adversarial conformance case.
rationale: The agent-entry side is already answered by LOG-0017 (AGENTS.md now requires executing the canonical inquiry model one question id per step). Whether the protocol itself gains an explicit invariant is a normative change and needs the owner. The current conformance instances test the protocol engine, not an AI dialogue, so the proposed test needs a new kind of case.
provenance: STAR-T-GATE v0.4 bridge test, 2026-10-30, owner observation
tests_performed: Compared the observation with LOG-0017 and AGENTS.md on main
Checked conformance/instances: no dialogue-level case exists
